summary: Do not claim CI passed unless CI status evidence is present.
proves: Readiness claims distinguish local validation from CI evidence.
does_not_prove: The project is ready to merge.
All project-local business behavior is valid.

assertions.description: CI pass language requires a CI status artifact with provider, run id, status, and URL.
assertions.given: a report that claims CI success
assertions.should: include provider, run id, status, and URL evidence
